notes.title: Railway Islands - first update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/d6e19dde55e5f62a5bf483e159040031ab5ef385.png

Version 1.0.1 brings some improvements to the game.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807930/Railway_Islands__Puzzle/

Improvements:

 2x speed option. When the train starts moving, a new button will appear, click on it to increase the train speed option by 2x.
 Camera zoom option. now you can zoom in and out of the camera using the + and - keys on the keyboard or w, s, up arrow and down arrow.
 Position of the locomotive button, now the button that starts the train is positioned in the lower center of the screen.


https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/f9b6e96159bfd3aa23228d372cb8a05e9d027021.jpg

Bug fix:

 Music volume not saved.



Thanks to everyone who is playing. It's been amazing to read your feedback and see that you're enjoying the game, it's very gratifying! Thank you very, very much for that!

Alysson N. Moraes - Developer.

notes.title: Space Elite Force II - Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/52c619aa59051335d6675010e23dd831de15479c.png
First game update brings some improvements to the default control settings, menu navigation and a map of the keyboard controls.

The game underwent rigorous tests in the recognition and remapping of controls, the tests were made with an Xbox One controller (Xinput) and generic Playstation 2. Some problems like starting with the inverted joystick axis have been resolved, but nothing very serious has been found.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/8b2354b8418700a6f6ba0259730d549312a7e0e1.jpg

Now, in the controls remap menu, a map of the keyboard controls will appear, if the chosen player has no control assigned to him.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/928f03fc2cd681e2698edabcbdcd82b1ff88aa8e.jpg

The navigation in side menus has also been improved, now you use buttons with 'Q' and 'E', RB and LB to navigate between the menus, this made navigation easier and easier to understand.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/6b0413a1eaa7f231621726a5bf93cee691da26da.jpg

We will continue to improve according to player feedback.

Att,
Alysson Moraes - Developer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/855850/Space_Elite_Force/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1204470/Space_Elite_Force_II/
